Package com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.channels

Class DisabledLightningChannelGateway

java.lang.Object
com.kerosene.kfe.adapters.out.rail.channels.DisabledLightningChannelGateway
All Implemented Interfaces:
LightningChannelGateway
public class DisabledLightningChannelGateway extends Object implements LightningChannelGateway
Fail-closed channel gateway when LND REST is disabled. Registered via LightningChannelGatewayConfiguration only when no other LightningChannelGateway bean exists.
